{"id":"com.footy1x.footytools","version":"1.1.14","url":"https://footy1x.store/footytools/FootyTools-1.1.14.zxp","sha256":"a545c875496d3fd274b7beea4829ad7720c9b45ff25cbdcc48ddde12971acaa0","size":12038293,"notes":"1.1.14 (27 Oct 2026)
- Hover previews: hold the mouse on a tile and a 1.6 s loop shows what that tool does (159 tools: every
  transition, in, out, shake, flash, look, hit, beat hit, text animation, fade, expression and speed tool).
  They're rendered from the real tools on a real football clip, so they look exactly like what you'll get.
  They work in the search results too, and the gear has a switch to turn them off.
- Fit to comp: the fit buttons now use After Effects' names (Fit to comp, Fit to comp width / height,
  Stretch to comp), so searching "fit to comp" finds them, and Fit to comp is on the Quick bar (key 6).
  Fit to comp fills the frame without squashing; Stretch to comp is After Effects' own Cmd+Opt+F.
- Ball tracking is steadier: on our test shot it now stays on the ball the whole way (112 of 120 frames,
  was 97). A ball stuck to a boot is measured properly. When it loses the ball it stops and holds instead of
  wandering onto a player, and "Check the ball" markers on the null show where to look. If it can't follow
  the ball at all, it says so.
- Tools that change the whole project (Remove unused, Reduce to this comp, Consolidate, Delete empty
  folders, All comps to size, Delete hidden, Clear all markers) now ask for a second click first.
- Windows (beta): AI slow-mo and AI upscale now run on Windows too (needs a Vulkan graphics card). Not
  tested on a PC yet: tell us how it goes.","published":"2026-10-27"}
